The Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash uses **antioxidant-rich green tea** and **glycolic acid** to gently exfoliate and control oil for a refreshed feel.

The The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Wash combines **2% salicylic acid and 2% niacinamide** to fight acne, regulate oil, and fade blemishes.

The Himalaya Neem Purifying Face Wash relies on **natural neem and turmeric** to purify oily skin and prevent everyday breakouts affordably.

The Foxtale Oil & Acne Control Face Wash features **salicylic acid, niacinamide, and cica** to clear congestion while calming redness and irritation.

The the Deconstruct Salicylic Acid Oil Control Facewash uses a dual-action formula of **salicylic acid and niacinamide** to control sebum and keep blackheads at bay.

The Dot & Key Watermelon Super Glow Vitamin C Face Wash Gel offers a gentle, sulfate-free gel cleanse infused with **watermelon and vitamin C** for oil control without a tight after-feel.
